quote.text: I tried YNAB or Mint and gave up

promise.text: How to restart a budget from today's money

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "money", "budget"

lines.text: Begin with current balances and unpaid commitments, not a receipt backlog.
Protect essentials and resolve shortfalls before rebuilding categories.

eyebrow.text: Make today the new starting point

items.text: Note the date and balances of each account used for spending.
Identify pending or unposted commitments without subtracting anything twice.
Check card statements and the actual payments you must fund.
List overdue bills and bills due before the next reliable deposit.
Protect necessary groceries, transport, and other essential spending.
Keep reserves and money promised to another purpose separate.

line.text: Those ask you to keep a whole system current. This asks for a few figures and does the keeping-up itself, so there is nothing to fall behind on.
